death.note: saint.gr heads the page «Αγιος Σοφιανος Επισκοπος Δρυϊνουπολεως Και Αργυροκαστρου (; - 1711)» and the narrative puts his resignation a few months before his death in that year: «Το 1711 μ.Χ., λίγους μήνες πριν τον θάνατό του, παραιτείται από τα ιερατικά καθήκοντα». It gives no year of birth.

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3723/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Nothing in the corpus answers to this name. The see is the page's own and goes in `office`; the page calls him the forerunner of Kosmas of Aetolia, whom the corpus keeps as `kosmas-of-aetolia`, so the two are related. **The page hedges his birthplace** — «Γεννήθηκε πιθανότατα στο χωριό Πολύτσιανη», most probably at the village of Polytsiani — so no `locations` are proposed and the hedge stands in the life. **The page is long and was read in its opening and closing stretches only**, some two thousand characters of the middle unread; the reader's report names the limit. The page's Ἀπολυτίκιον names him but is printed with neither an ἦχος nor a model, and the Μεγαλυνάριον is neither a troparion nor a kontakion, so no hymn is drafted. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
